text:
sarah (Finance): Heads up — promo credit CREDIT-2024-Q4 ($12,000) did not auto-apply to Dedicated invoice INV-2026-0047 generated this morning. Invoice shows full charge for Apr reserved capacity. Can someone investigate? @anita

anita (RevOps): looking — which org/account? org-id: rwd-cluster-prod. I see a contract credit CREDIT-CONTRACT-42 ($20k) but it has a 'hosted-only' flag in our ledger.

miguel (CloudOps): pinging billing-bot to get invoice metadata. billing-bot, can you dump credits applied to INV-2026-0047?

billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-0047 | total $54,231.00 | credits applied: none | promo credits available: CREDIT-2024-Q4 ($12,000, exp 2026-04-30), CREDIT-TRIAL-002 ($500, exp 2025-01-01) | contract credits: CREDIT-CONTRACT-42 ($20,000, hosted-only=true)

sarah (Finance): so the large contract credit is hosted-only? that seems wrong — this org runs Dedicated GPUs for inference. If the contract credit can't be used, we need to reissue or convert.

kai (Infrastructure): there's a billing tag mismatch on dedicated nodes: resource tag is `redwood:demand=dedicated` but billing label shows `service=hosted-api`. Filed CB ticket CB-7893. Might explain why credits didn't auto-apply.

anita (RevOps): options: 1) request manual credit reallocation for INV-2026-0047 (RevOps can approve), 2) ask sales/legal to convert contract credit scope, 3) re-tag infra (won't backfill past invoices).

miguel (CloudOps): prefer manual reallocation for now. Anita — can you authorize? Also we need to be careful re: expiry — promo CREDIT-2024-Q4 expires 2026-04-30.

anita (RevOps): approved. Filing manual apply now. Command: `/billing apply-credit INV-2026-0047 CREDIT-2024-Q4 --note "Dedicated invoice reallocation approved by RevOps"`

billing-bot: Action queued. Estimated result: CREDIT-2024-Q4 applied -> invoice balance reduces to $42,231.00. Internal ticket BILL-4321 created for audit.

sarah (Finance): thanks. Can we also get a short explainer for sales & AMs on credit scoping so we avoid this next time? @anita @miguel

anita (RevOps): will draft a 1-pager + playbook and post to #finance. It will include: tagging checklist, manual reallocation flow, and conversion request template.

miguel (CloudOps): noted. Follow-up: cb-7893 assigned to infra team to fix tagging automation so future invoices pick up the right credit scope.
